processing.name: Northern Basmati Export Milling Corridor (Haryana & Punjab)
products: Strategic Role: Global processing and export packaging corridor for Geographical Indication (GI) Basmati rice.
catchment: Catchment Areas: The entire Indo-Gangetic Plains certified Basmati GI tract: Majha and Doaba tracts (Punjab); GT Road belt (Haryana); and Western Uttar Pradesh (Bareilly, Rampur, Shahjahanpur, Aligarh).

paragraphs.text: 1. Northern Basmati Export Milling Corridor (Haryana & Punjab)
Strategic Role: Global processing and export packaging corridor for Geographical Indication (GI) Basmati rice.

Key Facilities: Large multinational corporate mills (KRBL/India Gate, LT Foods/Daawat, Kohinoor, GRM Overseas, Best Foods) located across Karnal, Taraori, Panipat, Kurukshetra (Haryana) and Amritsar, Ludhiana, Kapurthala (Punjab).

Infrastructure Profile: Multi-tier optical bichromatic and trichromatic color sorters, pneumatic rubber-roll shellers, mist-polishers, and multi-year climate-controlled storage godowns (essential for aging basmati grain to reduce cooking stickiness and boost length elongation).

Catchment Areas: The entire Indo-Gangetic Plains certified Basmati GI tract: Majha and Doaba tracts (Punjab); GT Road belt (Haryana); and Western Uttar Pradesh (Bareilly, Rampur, Shahjahanpur, Aligarh).

products: Strategic Role: India's largest single regional concentration of commercial parboiling and rice milling facilities. Purba Bardhaman alone operates over 500 modern rice mills.
catchment: Catchment Areas: Purba and Paschim Bardhaman, Hooghly, Bankura, Birbhum, and Nadia; supplies parboiled rice across West Bengal, Jharkhand, Bihar, Assam, and the Northeastern states.

paragraphs.text: 2. Eastern Parboiled Rice Milling Hub (Purba Bardhaman, West Bengal)
Strategic Role: India's largest single regional concentration of commercial parboiling and rice milling facilities. Purba Bardhaman alone operates over 500 modern rice mills.
Key Centers: Memari, Burdwan Sadar, Kalna, Galsi, and Katwa along the Damodar river basin.
Infrastructure Profile: Closed-circuit boiler soaking tanks, continuous mechanized mechanical dryers (LSU driers), and solvent extraction plants processing fresh rice bran.
Catchment Areas: Purba and Paschim Bardhaman, Hooghly, Bankura, Birbhum, and Nadia; supplies parboiled rice across West Bengal, Jharkhand, Bihar, Assam, and the Northeastern states.

protection.name: Brown Planthopper (BPH) & White-Backed Planthopper (WBPH) (Nilaparvata lugens, Sogatella furcifera)
protection.geography: All-India Commercial Belts (Devastating in Punjab, Haryana, WB, South)
protection.impact: Nymphs and adults aggregate in thousands at the base of tillers right above the water line; suck phloem sap; causes circular patches of crop to dry up, turn brown, and collapse completely ("Hopper Burn"); vectors Ragged Stunt and Grassy Stunt viruses.
protection.passage: Rice — source table 90, row 2. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Bacterial Leaf Blight (BLB) (Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae)
protection.geography: Intensive Alluvial & Deltaic Belts (Heavy in WB, AP, Telangana, UP)
protection.impact: Water-soaked to yellowish translucent stripes appear on leaf margins, expanding into wavy, straw-colored blighted lesions; milky bacterial ooze droplets form on young lesions during dewy mornings; systemic vascular infection causes seedling wilting ("Kresek" phase).
protection.passage: Rice — source table 90, row 3. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Sheath Blight (Rhizoctonia solani)
protection.geography: All-India Heavy-N Regimes (Severe in Punjab, Haryana, Eastern Belts)
protection.impact: Oval, greenish-grey, water-soaked spots with dark brown margins appear on leaf sheaths near the water level; lesions coalesce, creeping upward toward the flag leaf; irregular banded patterns; weakens tillers, causing widespread lodging.
protection.passage: Rice — source table 90, row 4. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Rice Blast (Leaf, Node & Neck Blast) (Magnaporthe oryzae / Pyricularia oryzae)
protection.geography: All Basmati & Hill Tracts (Punjab, Tarai UP, Himachal, J&K)
protection.impact: Spindle-shaped lesions with ash-grey centers and dark brown borders on leaves; dark necrotic girdling of stem nodes (Node Blast) and panicle base (Neck Blast); panicles snap at the neck, resulting in completely chaffy, empty white heads.

protection.name: Yellow Stem Borer (YSB) (Scirpophaga incertulas)
protection.impact: Monophagous pest; larvae bore into the central stem; feeding during the vegetative stage severs the growing vascular shoot, causing the central tiller to dry and die ("Dead Heart"); feeding during the reproductive stage severs the panicle base, producing completely erect, empty, bleached white panicles ("White Head").

protection.name: Rice Weevil & Lesser Grain Borer (Sitophilus oryzae, Rhyzopertha dominica)
protection.geography: All Commercial Warehouses & Central Pool Godowns
protection.impact: Adult weevils and larvae bore into stored milled and raw grains; hollow out kernels, generating fine flour dust and heating; reduces seed viability and market grade.
